limitations: RTX3090 / Python3.12 Torch2.4 CUDA12 measurements do not qualify B200 / Python3.13 Torch2.11 CUDA13.
Synthetic Runtime integration uses cached raw logits and normalized synthetic teacher probabilities; transformer forwards, actual vLLM scheduler/rejection sampling and GRPO are excluded.
No expensive training, downloading, dependency installation or SpecNaacl source edits performed.
AAL preservation on real B200 rollouts remains unmeasured; numerical/sampler tests preserve the existing objective and decisions within FP32 tolerances.

raw_cache.scope: Synthetic exact valid-row copy vs retained indexing. Oracle row IDs supplied; compaction/discovery excluded. No head recomputation or real rollout.
raw_cache.decision: retain original logits; valid-row copy adds work and cannot release originals before verification; head recomputation is not qualified for exact bias/processing/dtype parity

validation.local_environment_issue_resolved: One intermediate regression attempt hit the installer 256MiB free-disk guard; removed only task-generated /tmp pytest artifacts, then full 333-test run passed. Production installer/test behavior not changed.

calibration: schema3 implementation revision, exact GPU/capability/dtypes/hidden/vocab/rank/topk/block/stream, nearest compatible batch and density interpolation
